articles.summary: ACM’s advanced Single-wafer SPM process chamber equipped with patented SPM nozzle cover delivers SPM particle performance better than or matching traditional RCA process. SPM nozzle cover with built-in exhaust manifold reduces particles, extends PM cycles, and supports high-temperature sulfuric peroxide processes.
articles.title: SPM Wafer Cleaning for Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing
